model: canonical public source-only relevance triage, not network evaluator model
preobservation_disclosure: The two original public response fixtures and their GHSA list similarity were manually inspected before this protocol was drafted; protocol is frozen BEFORE Phase5R automated implementation, not before original source discovery, and is NOT a blind holdout.
comparison_method: Two externally captured paid tasks are different, but both requests use the exact same canonical SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL route envelope params.target and the same reported Miner 77003; compare answer-identity stability across tasks, NOT independent ranking quality.
target_match_requirements: For package query, require package name and version from exact input; generic GHSA feed is off-target only when it contains no package-specific advisory metadata or textual package name and is a long broad catalogue.
synthetic_adversarial_matrix: modified package versions or names must not be hardcoded to lodash
when source has no dependency context, generic advisory list cannot be treated as source diff review
keyword padding without package version/advisory support cannot produce correctness gold
an actually package-specific response is still structurally only, not a licensed accuracy label
HTTP 200 paid alone does not imply task compliance
intent spoofing or changed request envelope must fail
exact public source Git blobs must be checked before original summary
